summary: machine_measure_test.sh against private copies of the measurement drivers of tools/dev, each fault failing its row

argv: mkdir -p ${WORK}/dev && cd ${SRC}/tools/dev && exec cp machine_net_in.sh machine_load.sh machine_load_session.sh machine_identity.sh ${WORK}/dev/

faults.name: cleanup
faults.summary: the inbound driver keeps its known-hosts file

faults.name: deadline
faults.summary: a session counts a build by its start, not its finish, against the window

lines: late completion counted inside the window

faults.name: stagger
faults.summary: the load driver starts its sessions without a second between them

lines: sessions started without a second between them

faults.name: slot
faults.summary: the identity check takes a machine booted from another slot

lines: a machine booted from another slot was measured

faults.name: trial
faults.summary: the identity check takes a machine with an armed trial

lines: a machine with an armed trial was measured

faults.name: kernel
faults.summary: the identity check takes a machine running another kernel

lines: a machine running another kernel was measured

faults.name: inbound-unchecked
faults.summary: the inbound driver goes on when the identity check refuses

lines: the inbound driver timed a machine the identity check refused

faults.name: load-unchecked
faults.summary: the load driver goes on when the identity check refuses

lines: the load driver started sessions on a machine the identity check refused
